svg.title: Accelerator and engine support at a glance
svg.desc: Which inference engine runs on which accelerator, and what has run on real hardware. Device monitoring: NVIDIA and Apple Silicon verified; AMD, Hygon, MetaX, Moore Threads and T-Head built in, awaiting reports. llama.cpp: NVIDIA verified, AMD pinned, Apple Silicon verified, Hygon pinned, MetaX add, Moore Threads add, T-Head add, CPU only pinned. vLLM: NVIDIA verified, AMD add, Hygon add, MetaX add, Moore Threads add. vLLM-Omni: NVIDIA pinned. SGLang: NVIDIA partial, AMD add. SGLang Diffusion: NVIDIA pinned, AMD add, Apple Silicon add. TensorRT-LLM: NVIDIA partial. MLX: Apple Silicon verified. mlx-audio: Apple Silicon pinned. whisper.cpp: NVIDIA add, AMD add, Apple Silicon pinned, CPU only pinned. stable-diffusion.cpp: NVIDIA add, AMD pinned, Apple Silicon pinned, CPU only pinned. Custom engine: NVIDIA add, AMD add, Apple Silicon add, Hygon add, MetaX add, Moore Threads add, T-Head add, CPU only add. Marks: verified on real hardware, partial, built in (pinned build or image) awaiting reports, add your own build or image; combinations not listed are not supported.
